correctness.rationale: Finite exact 24-bit face enumeration yields 18,721 simplices. The complete directed Hasse graph is acyclic after 9,353 explicit matching pairs; 15 critical cells consist of one 0-, six 4-, eight 5-cells. Integral Morse D5 has rank five and a determinant-one 5×5 minor, proving a wedge of S4 and three S5 with no integral torsion. Direct mod-two boundary ranks corroborate the dimensions. All 96 natural automorphisms are checked and their exact fixed-orbit Lefschetz numbers identify the only possible rational H4/H5 characters by one-dimensional candidate enumeration and character orthogonality.
